calculation.description: Multiply 20-day momentum by a 10-day return efficiency ratio, then cross-sectionally residualize against contemporaneous 5-day returns. Higher values indicate persistent momentum not explained by the short-term reversal/continuation component. All inputs are lagged or observable at decision time.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive across 2020-2022 (+0.040557), 2023-2024 (+0.029594), and 2025-2027 (+0.028193). Small 15-asset cross-section requires conservative interpretation.
